interface.signature: def floodFill(self, image: List[List[int]], sr: int, sc: int, newColor: int) -> List[List[int]]

preconditions.description: The number of rows in the image must be between 1 and 100.
The number of columns in the image must be between 1 and 100.
The starting coordinates (sr, sc) must be within the bounds of the image.
The newColor must be a valid pixel value between 0 and 10.

postconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= pixel <= 10 for pixel in row) for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: All pixel values in the returned image must be valid pixel values between 0 and 10.
The pixel at the starting coordinates (sr, sc) must be updated to newColor.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i][j] == image[i][j] for i in range(len(image)) for j in range(len(image[0])) if (i, j) not in flood_fill_pixels)
postconditions.description: Pixels not connected to the starting pixel must retain their original color.
